overall_intent: A photographic Lovecraftian discovery in which a laboratory sample exceeds the human scale of its measuring enclosure, retaining the supplied portrait face/hair appearance.

spatial_depth.reason: The scene depends on a continuous near-to-far material path and a small frame contradicting its immense interior.
spatial_depth.expressive_goal: Make the limited measuring enclosure and the unsettling interior depth readable as one physical encounter.
observable_targets: continuous surface receding through the grid
small containment boundary and large interior depth in one view
owner_relations: The tissue belongs to one sample and passes behind the measuring lattice.
The secondary reference-guided person watches that same sample.
required_constraints: Preserve cosmic horror beyond ordinary human comprehension.
Preserve the supplied face/hair appearance and its narrow reference scope.
preserved_choices: The nonhuman sample remains visually primary for this local comparison.
open_scope: Depth arrangement, occlusion, relative scale, light separation and perspective may be locally refined.
spatial_depth.role_focus: A tangible small scientific sample whose continuous surface recedes into a much larger interior; show the physical containment frame, near material and distant interior together so that depth itself defeats ordinary measurement.
spatial_depth.scene_context: A quiet refrigerated marine-biology workbench. A withdrawn sampling probe has paused beside a quartz cell; a secondary observer uses the supplied portrait only for face and hair appearance.

grounds.quote: The small physical containment lattice and the immense continuous tissue interior must be visible together.

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: This is depth ordering and relative scale among visible owners, not proof of a hidden organism history. Only the exact spatial_depth role is requested to keep the material study focused; request-topic and baseline searches remain independent.
